_source: CropGraph 2 (https://github.com/Cropgraph/cropgraph), data CC-BY-4.0: USDA Cooperative Extension publications + Washington State University Extension + Cornell Cooperative Extension + The Old Farmer's Almanac + USDA GRIN (germplasm) + Seed Savers Exchange yearbooks + Fedco/Johnny's/Baker Creek/Strictly Medicinal seed catalogs (cultivar descriptors). Conservative ranges suitable for general North American gardening; coastal, mountain, and desert microclimates may shift dates 2-3 weeks. Schema v2 (2026-05-13): category enum extended to 14 values (added grain, mushroom, native, medicinal, fiber, forage, sprout).
_format: key = 'genus species'; n common name (en); c category; s season; d days to harvest [min,max]; t min soil °C; w windows [action i=sow indoors s=sow outdoors t=plant out, anchor s=last spring frost f=first fall frost, from, to days]; f family; g good companions; x antagonists (keys)
